fullPassage: When Steve Jobs was a college student, he did not know what he wanted to do in the future. He felt uncertain about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him figure out what to do with his life. He decided to start checking out things that seemed interesting to him. One day, he was walking around the college grounds and a poster caught his eye. The handwritten letters on every poster were elegant and beautiful. He became fascinated with the art of producing beautiful handwriting, also known as calligraphy, and decided to attend a calligraphy class. He gained an understanding of letter styles and learned to adjust the spacing between various combinations of letters. At that time, he did not expect that learning it would be useful or applicable to his life in the future. However, later when he developed his own computer operating system, he incorporated what he learned from that class into designing the system. As a result, he developed his own computer system with visually appealing letter styles. The artistic letters became a sensation at the time and are still widely used. His innovative incorporation of calligraphy into the world of technology, which started from his personal interest, has inspired many other corporations' computer system designs.

questions.passage: When Steve Jobs was a college student, he did not know what he wanted to do in the future. He felt uncertain about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him figure out what to do with his life. He decided to start checking out things that seemed interesting to him. One day, he was walking around the college grounds and a poster caught his eye. The handwritten letters on every poster were elegant and beautiful. He became fascinated with the art of producing beautiful handwriting, also known as calligraphy, and decided to attend a calligraphy class. He gained an understanding of letter styles and learned to adjust the spacing between various combinations of letters. At that time, he did not expect that learning it would be useful or applicable to his life in the future. However, later when he developed his own computer operating system, he incorporated what he learned from that class into designing the system. As a result, he developed his own computer system with visually appealing letter styles. The artistic letters became a sensation at the time and are still widely used. His innovative incorporation of calligraphy into the world of technology, which started from his personal interest, has inspired many other corporations' computer system designs.

det.korean: 미래가 불확실했지만 흥미로운 것들을 적극적으로 탐색하여 캘리그래피를 만나게 된 이야기.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 관심사 탐색: 정규 수업에 의문 → 흥미로운 것 탐색 → 캘리그래피 발견. 핵심 메시지.

❌ ② 캘리그래피 역사: 캘리그래피의 역사가 아니라 Jobs의 경험.
❌ ④ 포스터 디자인: 포스터는 계기일 뿐, 주제가 아님.
det.tip: 주제 = 글 전체의 중심 메시지. Jobs가 '스스로 흥미를 따라 탐색한 것'이 핵심.

det.korean: 개인적 관심에서 시작된 캘리그래피가 예상치 못하게 기술 혁신의 영감이 되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 핵심 3요소 포함: 개인 관심(personal interest) + 예상 못함(did not expect) + 기술 혁신 영감(inspired corporations).
❌ ① 정규 수업 집중 → 오히려 의문을 품고 다른 것을 탐색.
❌ ② 기여 못함 → 큰 영감을 주었음(has inspired).
❌ ③ 처음부터 확신 → did not expect, 기대하지 않았음.
